description: This PHP file defines the BuzzPostModel class, which implements serialization and normalization of BuzzPost entities for API responses. It sets filters and attribute mappings for serialization of BuzzPost data related to a specific employee.

classes.name: BuzzPostModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing BuzzPost data for API responses, implementing filtering and attribute mapping for employee and post information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BuzzPostModel with a BuzzPost entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
